correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the weighted height reduction y_i=sum_j x_(i,j), with W_a(y)=binom(y+a-1,a-1), and the fractional stable-set odd cycle Q_m. Every vertex with a zero coordinate is integral by bipartite-path total unimodularity; the only nonintegral vertex is c=(1/2,...,1/2), where B=I+cyclic shift has determinant 2. Parity-restricted tangent-cone lattice summation and Brion localization yield the analytic difference exp(t/2 sum s_i)*prod_j(1+exp(-(B^-1 s)_j))^-1. The weight differential operator has order m(a-1); its top t coefficient is 2^-ma/((a-1)!)^m, proving exact degree and period 2. Independently computed weighted integer-point counts and interpolated parity polynomials for (m,a)=(3,1),(5,1),(3,2),(5,2), including the stated cubic and quintic polynomial identities. Finite cases only corroborate the Brion-based all-m,a argument.
